It is nestled among various folded clothes, which include items in blue, green, white, and gray. The bed has a white quilted cover, and the dog is partially covered by a green blanket. In the bottom right corner of the image, there are beige slippers with a textured, fuzzy material, suggesting someone is relaxing at home. A person's feet are visible, wearing the slippers, indicating they are likely the owner of the dog
